rationale:
I certify this exact plan (canonical candidate ref sha256:88e15cc7b72f19c64c6131fb5bf805f3368723139d0a514232e406b3a056de8b) for submission to The Eye. This approval grants no implementation authority and does not start Task 1; only a separate Eye decision can do that.

Authority boundaries are correct and internally consistent. The plan repeatedly and precisely maintains that model consensus is never authorization, The Eye authorizes exact roots, Grok/Gemini are mandatory only at profile gates P2/C2 while remaining advisory in the TELOS council, and the required trio claude/agy/codex is untouched (profile telos_handoff block plus explicit tests). The Execution Preconditions block is exemplary: it computes the canonical candidate ref (correctly distinguishing it from the raw file SHA-256, which is transport-integrity only), validates a complete Eye implementation-authorization record with Ed25519 signature verification against a pinned tracked public key at the reviewed HEAD, includes in-memory negative controls (mutated subject_ref, scope, task range, key ID, signature), and explicitly states the currently recorded Clotho authority (authz-008) intentionally fails this check — so Task 1 is structurally blocked until The Eye publishes the exact grant. This is exactly the fail-closed posture required.

Checkpoint semantics match the mandate: Icarus alone consolidates validated findings/dispositions into the strict plugin-owned lifecycle-round checkpoint after every Daedalus/Icarus review-fix round, before precompact/rotation; save is capability-gated so role strings/env/hooks/mechanics cannot mint it; mechanics are read-only and non-authoritative; precompact fails closed on missing/stale state. The six-field minimal payload with derived (not caller-supplied) candidate identity, boundary, round ID, stable finding IDs, stage/owner, and next-action table is tightly closed against injection of prose, mechanics, or duplicate authority state.

The no-caps rule is implemented as specified (automatic_limits all null, 25-consecutive-non-pass test proving no counter terminates) while explicitly preserving Eye pause/cancel/amend/adjudicate via separately signed prefix-bound authority artifacts with one-time authority ID/ref use and mutate-away/mutate-back reuse rejection. Required-seat substitution is forbidden at profile, engine, and adapter layers with dedicated negative tests. Private reasoning and credentials are rejected at every persistence boundary (assertPersistable, closed envelopes, adapter discard of raw responses, CREDENTIAL_REJECTED without redacted storage).

The decision-record requirement is met: every pass, non-pass, provider death, mutation, retry, invalidation, and Eye action publishes a crash-atomic controller-signed record in signed index/predecessor-chained journals; JSONL append is never authority; the invocation-started/prepared/terminal operation protocol with non-circular prepared commitments makes every crash boundary total and idempotent, with deterministic recovery that never re-invokes providers and never reads a clock. Disk-only replay is the sole derived state; the artifact-ref vs embedded tree-root distinction is handled consistently across engine, disk truth, Eye acceptance, closure, export, and demo (a subtle failure mode many designs get wrong). Gate order (P1→P2→Eye→C1→C2→disk→acceptance) is enforced by profile topology plus reducer stage matching plus replay prefix validation, and mutations correctly invalidate downstream gates per domain.

The plan is test-driven throughout (failing tests precede implementation in every task), zero-dependency Node ESM (node: imports only, node:test, no shell for disk truth or transports), and sufficient to re-derive canonical artifacts, signatures, provenance, gate order, disk truth, and the TELOS export from disk via the detached verifier operating on bundle bytes plus separately pinned Eye trust. Source-vs-cache discipline is explicit: implementation targets /home/colchis/plugins/multi-model-seats, the installed cache is never source, and Task 11 proves byte-exact source/cache package identity through installer metadata rather than hard-coded paths.

Non-blocking observations for the record (not defects requiring revision): (1) the plan is extremely dense and its exactness demands equally exact implementation discipline — the per-task focused test commands mitigate this; (2) a few golden hash vectors (e.g., the canonical-JSON and raw-byte refs in Task 1 tests) are asserted as literals and must be verified against actual computation during implementation — if any literal were wrong the failing test would catch it, which is the correct fail-closed direction; (3) Step 9's production lifecycle correctly stops with PRODUCTION_LIFECYCLE_PENDING when live seats or fresh Eye signatures are unavailable, so certification of this plan does not imply the production run will complete without further Eye action; (4) the design's open question on Seat 5/agy is resolved in-plan (outside the profile, participating only in the existing TELOS flow), consistent with the mandate. My confidence is medium rather than high solely due to the plan's scale: the internal cross-references among Tasks 3/5/8 (commitment scheme, reservation, CAS semantics) are consistent as written, but their breadth leaves residual risk that only implementation-time tests can fully discharge — which is precisely what the plan's TDD structure provides.
